name: Khazan

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Name Over the Door, docs/story/side_quests.md). Since 2026-10-26 his numbers are the stat block Ashwin chose (2026-10-21: an Acerak block, renamed Khazan, without Invoke Curse and the Talisman of the Sphere), CR 23. Departures: one Concentration at a time, not two (Multi-Concentration isn't built); Detect Thoughts and Teleport aren't on his list (the engine doesn't run them in a fight); Misty Step as a Bonus Action is text only; the old immunity to nonmagical weapons is left out (the 2024 rules have none). His lair and his name are the game's own. While his name over the tower door stands he can't be destroyed, only driven back into it. Drawn with Exethanter's sprite.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.summary: Five times a day, a failed saving throw that would put a condition on him, or one against a big spell, becomes a success.
traits.text: When Khazan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, five times a day.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns Undead.
traits.text: Khazan has Advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns Undead.

traits.name: Multi-Concentration
traits.summary: He can concentrate on two spells at once (in the game, one).
traits.text: Khazan can maintain Concentration on two spells at once.

traits.name: Remembered
traits.summary: His name over the tower door holds him in the world. While it stands, he can't be destroyed: at the end he comes apart into dust and goes back into it.
traits.text: Khazan's phylactery is his own name, cut into the lintel of his tower and spoken by everyone who opens the door. While it stands, a body destroyed comes apart into dust that goes back into the name, and he forms again below the tower. Unmake the name, and the next body is the last.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.summary: A freezing touch: 3d6+5 Cold, and the target is Paralyzed until the start of his next turn.
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack Roll: +15, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Khazan's next turn.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.summary: A bolt of raw magic at a foe up to 120 ft away: 4d12+5 Force.
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack Roll: +15, range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Casts wizard spells (Int, DC 23, +15 to hit): at will up to Fireball and Lightning Bolt at 5th level, slots from 4th to 9th.
actions.text: Khazan is a 20th-level spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). At will: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Fireball (5th level), Lightning Bolt (5th level), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Shield, Counterspell, Misty Step and Sleet Storm. 4th level (3 slots): Blight, Ice Storm, Phantasmal Killer. 5th (3 slots): Cloudkill, Hold Monster, Wall of Force. 6th (3 slots): Chain Lightning, Circle of Death, Disintegrate. 7th (2 slots): Finger of Death, Plane Shift. 8th (2 slots): Maze, Mind Blank. 9th (2 slots): Power Word Kill, Time Stop, Meteor Swarm, Prismatic Wall.

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.summary: Teleports up to 30 ft to a space he can see (text only in the game).
bonus_actions.text: Khazan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.summary: Casts Counterspell or Shield as a Reaction.
reactions.text: Khazan casts Counterspell or Shield in response to that spell's trigger.

legendary_strikes.name: Disrupt Life
legendary_strikes.summary: Everything living within 20 ft: DC 20 Con save, 12d6 Necrotic, half on a success.
legendary_strikes.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature within 20 feet of Khazan that isn't Undead. Failure: 42 (12d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

options.name: Deathly Teleport
options.summary: Teleports up to 60 ft; each creature within 5 ft of the space he left takes 2d10 Necrotic.

options.name: Disrupt Life
options.summary: Everything living within 20 ft: DC 20 Con save, 12d6 Necrotic, half on a success.

lair_actions.name: Every Name He Knows
lair_actions.summary: Two foes he can see hear their own names whispered from every shelf; DC 15 Wis save or 2d6 Psychic and Frightened until his next turn.
lair_actions.text: Every book in the undercroft whispers the name of up to two creatures Khazan can see. Each makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of Khazan's next turn.

lair_actions.name: The Lake Comes Through
lair_actions.summary: Two foes he can see: the cold of the lake over them comes through the stone; DC 15 Con save, 3d6 Cold, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: The cold of the lake overhead comes down through the stone onto up to two creatures Khazan can see. Each makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) Cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

summary: The archmage who built the tower on the tarn, before the count was born. He became a lich the cheap way: not with souls but with his own name, cut over his door so that everyone who comes in says it. Courteous, curious and very old, he collects the names of his visitors. His touch freezes, his bursts tear, and his undercroft whispers your name back to you.
